blocked_examples: fast shipping; rush shipping; quick delivery; same-day shipping; guaranteed delivery date
why_blocked: No current market-specific proof supports delivery-speed promises across paid markets.
evidence_required_before_use: Market-specific checkout delivery estimates, source policy text, fulfillment/provider proof, and recent delivery evidence.

blocked_examples: warehouse; local stock; stocked inventory; nearby inventory; store pickup; guaranteed on-hand stock
why_blocked: Owner clarified DLM is dropshipping with no physical store and no owned physical inventory.
evidence_required_before_use: Do not use unless the business model changes and owner provides explicit proof; platform in_stock labels are salability diagnostics only.

blocked_examples: best seller; most popular; top-rated; viral; trending; customer favorite
why_blocked: No fresh verified sales-rank or review proof was provided for paid creative.
evidence_required_before_use: Recent sales/order evidence by SKU or category, date range, and comparison set; or verified review/rating system readback.

blocked_examples: 5 stars; thousands of reviews; loved by customers; rated best
why_blocked: No verified review count or rating source is in the current paid-growth evidence.
evidence_required_before_use: Live review app evidence, product or brand scope, count/rating source, and screenshot or API readback.

blocked_examples: sale; discount; coupon; limited-time offer; free gift; promo code
why_blocked: No current storefront-visible promo terms were verified for paid use.
evidence_required_before_use: Live offer evidence, owner-approved terms, start/end dates, coupon rules, and destination-page consistency.

blocked_examples: in stock now; always available; guaranteed availability; ships from local stock
why_blocked: Availability cannot be turned into warehouse or guaranteed-stock claims for a dropshipping business.
evidence_required_before_use: Feed/PDP eligibility proof for salability only; no stock guarantee language.

blocked_examples: guaranteed fit; no-risk returns; free returns; easy free return shipping
why_blocked: Return shipping remains customer-paid in current memory; no fit guarantee proof exists.
evidence_required_before_use: Current refund/return policy source text and owner approval for exact wording.

why_blocked: Prior account-level assets with broad catalog-size claims were paused as unsupported.
evidence_required_before_use: Live destination count by collection, date-stamped proof, and exact scope in the claim.

blocked_examples: free shipping; ships free; free delivery
why_blocked: Some checkout rates can be free, but ad claims need country-specific proof and policy consistency.
evidence_required_before_use: Country-specific checkout rate readback, current policy/source confirmation, and owner approval for target countries.

blocked_examples: items waiting; cart expires; complete your order now; limited availability
why_blocked: Could imply urgency or availability that is not proven and can be risky for retargeting.
evidence_required_before_use: Verified platform policy fit, audience scope, and owner-approved wording; safer default is revisit/browse language.
